content: Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane Bulu Asʋ́n Ɔkanda

Roma owíe dɛhɛn Tiberio iwíegyí ofí dúanusɩtɔ á, Bulu lɛ́bláa mʋ igyí ɔhapʋ́ Sakaria mʋ bi Yohane dimbísʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔdáa mʋ asʋ́n ɔkan. (Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Pontio Pilato dɛ́ Yudea ɔmásʋ́ gyí. Herode dɛ́ Galilea ɔmásʋ́ gyí. Herode mʋ dɛhɛn Filipo ɛ́ dɛ́ Iturea pʋ́ Trakoniti ɔmásʋ́ gyí, Lisania ɛ́ dɛ́ Abilene ɔmásʋ́ gyí. Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn ánɩ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ ɛ́ gyí Hana mʋa Kaiafa.)
Mʋ́ sʋ Yohane léki Yordan bʋnkpa ɔnɔ́, ɔdɛ ɔkan da blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩdamli klʋntɔ, amlɩsi lakpan bwɛ. Bulu osikie mlɩ, ambɔ mlɩ asú.”

content.text: Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́Yesaia lɔ́wanlɩ́n Yohane ɩwɩ asʋ́n wá mʋ ɔwʋlʋ́tɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content: Ɔdɔm bɛba Yohane wá bɛɛ, ɔbɔ́ amʋ́ asú. Ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Abɛ abí-aná, ntɔ gyá mlɩ, mlɩsrɩ́ Bulu ɩsʋbɩtɩ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbá ámʋ?
Mʋ́mʋ́ mlɩswie abí oduá ibósuná ánɩ́ lɛ́lɛ́ mlɩladámlí klʋntɔ. Mlɩmákɩ mlɩaa, mlɩ náin gyí Abraham. Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, Bulu ɔbɛ́talɩ́ há abwi ánfɩ ɩbɛ́damlí Abraham abí-aná.
Séi á, Bulu lapʋ́ ɛfɛ́ yi nyí-atsitsitɔ. Oyígyíoyí ánɩ́ imoswie abi wankláán á, bókun mʋ́ dá, wá mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ogyá.”
Ɔdɔm amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yohane bɛɛ, “Ntɔ mɛɛ abwɛ́ɛ?”
Yohane lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́á fʋbʋ atadɩɛ anyɔ á, pʋ kʋlɛ ha ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔma kʋkʋ. Fʋ́á fʋbʋ atogyihɛ ɛ́ bwɛ mʋ́ alɩ.”
Lampóo ahɔ́pʋ akʋ ɛ́ bɛba asú ɔbɔkpá. Bɛfɩtɛ́ Yohane bɛɛ, “Osunápʋ́, ntɔ ilehián ánɩ́ abɔ́bwɛ?”
Yohane lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩmátswɩ dɩnká ahá. Mlɩhɔ tɔ́á bɛɛ mlɩhɔ́ɔ.”
Ɩsá akɔpʋ́ akʋ ɛ́ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yohane bɛɛ, “Anɩ ɛ́ mɛ́, ntɔ abwɛ́ɛ?” Yohane lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩmápʋ ɔwʋnlɩ́n swɩ́ɩ́ ɔhaa kɔ́ba, ntɛ́ɛ wá afunu dɩ́nká ɔhaasʋ. Mlɩ akatua igyí mlɩ ansɩ́.”
Ɩ́nɩá amʋ́ ansɩ́ dɩn Kristo amʋsʋ, bʋdɛ mʋ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ sʋ á, ɩmɔwánkɩ́ amʋ́ nɩ́ Yohane gyí Kristo amʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ Yohane lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔkʋá ɔdʋn mɩ bʋ ɔma ɔbá. Mmɔfʋn ánɩ́ nɛ́sankɩ́ mʋ ntʋkʋta ɔfɛ́ kʋ́ráá. Mɩ́ mʋ́ á, ntsu ndɛpʋbɔ́ mlɩ asú. Mʋ ɔbɔ́pʋ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ pʋ́ ogyá bɔ́ mlɩ asú nɩ́.
Ɔdɛ mʋ ɩlɩ́n, ɔbɔ́pʋfúní ntɛ́tɛ lɛ́ ayó ámʋtɔ. Ɔbɛ́kpa ayó ámʋ wá mʋ odudutɔ. Támɛ ɔbɛ́fɛɩ́ ofuníkpá ɩnʋ wankláán, kpá ntɛ́tɛ amʋ wá ogyá ánɩ́ ɩtamaduntɔ.”
Yohane lɛ́da asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan, bláa ahá ámʋ asʋ́n tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋdámli klʋntɔ.
Ɩsʋ ogyípʋ́ Herode laswɩɩ́ mʋ dɛhɛn Filipo mʋ ka Herodia tsía, trá bwɛ lalahɛ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ tsɩ́a mʋ́tɔ́. Mʋ́ sʋ Yohane lékiná há mʋ.
Mʋ́á ɩdʋn kʋ́ráá gyí, Herode lɛ́ha bɛkɩtá Yohane wá obu.
Yesu Asúbɔ
Brɛ́á Yohane dɛ́ ahá ámʋ asú bɔ á, Yesu ɛ́ lɛ́ba, Yohane lɔ́bɔ mʋ asú. Brɛ́á Yesu dɛ́ mpáɩ bɔ á, nwʋlʋ́táa lefinkí,
Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ lɛ́damlí fɛ́ abrɔ́dʋma, kplɩ́ bogyonká mʋsʋ. Ɔmɛ kʋ lotsu ɔsʋ́sʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́gyí mɩ́ bíá ntɔdwɛ́, mɩ ansɩ́ tɛhɩ́ɛ́ gyi fʋ́ ɩwɩ nɩ́.”
Yesu Anáin Ɩlɩ́ntɔ
Brɛ́á Yesu lɔ́hɔ fɛ́ nfí adʋasa á, olefi Bulu asʋ́n ɔkanda asɩ. Ahá mʋ́ bʋyin ánɩ́ Yosef mʋ bi nɩ́. Yosef mʋ sɩ gyí Eli.
Eli mʋ sɩ gyí Martat. Martat mʋ sɩ gyí Lewi. Lewi mʋ sɩ gyí Melki. Melki mʋ sɩ gyí Yanai. Yanai mʋ sɩ gyí Yosef.
Yosef mʋ sɩ gyí Martatia. Martatia mʋ sɩ gyí Amos. Amos mʋ sɩ gyí Nahum. Nahum mʋ sɩ gyí Hesli. Hesli mʋ sɩ gyí Nagai.
Nagai mʋ sɩ gyí Mahat. Mahat mʋ sɩ gyí Martatia. Martatia mʋ sɩ gyí Semein. Semein mʋ sɩ gyí Yosek. Yosek mʋ sɩ gyí Yoda.
Yoda mʋ sɩ gyí Yohanan. Yohanan mʋ sɩ gyí Resa. Resa mʋ sɩ gyí Serubabel. Serubabel mʋ sɩ gyí Sealtiel. Sealtiel mʋ sɩ gyí Neri.
Neri mʋ sɩ gyí Melki. Melki mʋ sɩ gyí Adi. Adi mʋ sɩ gyí Kosam. Kosam mʋ sɩ gyí Elmadam. Elmadam mʋ sɩ gyí Er.
Er mʋ sɩ gyí Yosua. Yosua mʋ sɩ gyí Elieser. Elieser mʋ sɩ gyí Yorim. Yorim mʋ sɩ gyí Martat. Martat mʋ sɩ gyí Lewi.
Lewi mʋ sɩ gyí Simeon. Simeon mʋ sɩ gyí Yuda. Yuda mʋ sɩ gyí Yosef. Yosef mʋ sɩ gyí Yonam. Yonam mʋ sɩ gyí Eliakim.
Eliakim mʋ sɩ gyí Melea. Melea mʋ sɩ gyí Mena. Mena mʋ sɩ gyí Martata. Martata mʋ sɩ gyí Natan. Natan mʋ sɩ gyí Owíe Dawid.
Owíe Dawid mʋ sɩ gyí Yisai. Yisai mʋ sɩ gyí Obed. Obed mʋ sɩ gyí Boas. Boas mʋ sɩ gyí Salmon. Salmon mʋ sɩ gyí Nahson.
Nahson mʋ sɩ gyí Aminadab. Aminadab mʋ sɩ gyí Admin. Admin mʋ sɩ gyí Arni. Arni mʋ sɩ gyí Hesron. Hesron mʋ sɩ gyí Peres. Peres mʋ sɩ gyí Yuda.
Yuda mʋ sɩ gyí Yakob. Yakob mʋ sɩ gyí Isak. Isak mʋ sɩ gyí Abraham. Abraham mʋ sɩ gyí Tera. Tera mʋ sɩ gyí Nahor.
Nahor mʋ sɩ gyí Serug. Serug mʋ sɩ gyí Reu. Reu mʋ sɩ gyí Peleg. Peleg mʋ sɩ gyí Eber. Eber mʋ sɩ gyí Sala.
Sala mʋ sɩ gyí Kainan. Kainan mʋ sɩ gyí Arfaksad. Arfaksad mʋ sɩ gyí Sem. Sem mʋ sɩ gyí Noa, Noa ɛ́ mʋ sɩ gyí Lamek.
Lamek mʋ sɩ gyí Metusela. Metusela mʋ sɩ gyí Enok. Enok mʋ sɩ gyí Yared. Yared mʋ sɩ gyí Mehalaleel. Mehalaleel mʋ sɩ gyí Kenan.
Kenan mʋ sɩ gyí Enos. Enos mʋ sɩ gyí Set. Set mʋ sɩ gyí Adam. Adam ɛ́ mʋ sɩ gyí Bulu.
